supported_definition: Ground facts/conjunctions plus universal Horn implications with explicit negation; single ground-literal query; no existential, disjunction, XOR or biconditional.

full_validation_conservative.interpretation: Unsupported FOL formulas are conservatively predicted Unknown; this score exposes the current grammar-coverage limitation and is not presented as a competitive full-FOLIO result.

interpretation: FOLIO is single-context, so perspective indexing and Rashomon proof selection are dormant for class prediction. The experiment validates the semantic Tableau logical core. Multi-context scope gain and multi-proof explanation gain are evaluated separately.
